name: negative dip
description: A slow lowering from the top of a dip, stepping or jumping back up each rep. It builds the strength for full dips on parallel bars.
instructions: Jump or step into a straight-arm support on parallel bars.
Lean slightly forward and keep your shoulders pulled down.
Bend your elbows and lower yourself over three to five seconds.
Stop when your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Put your feet down, return to the top and repeat.
